Root cause confirmed (AC1) test by test from Windows job 133527199439 (run 43932173744): e.g. `assert 'tests\\test_thing.py' == 'tests/test_thing.py'` (check_destructive_test_exec), `src\\rebar\\live.py:1: deprecated vocabulary` (criteria vocabulary), `ValueError: path is on mount 'C:', start on mount 'D:'` (check_skill_frontmatter relpath), `'infra\\scripts\\foo.sh' == 'infra/scripts/foo.sh'` (deploy manifest), `OSError: [WinError 10106]` at `import asyncio` in children whose hand-built env lacks SYSTEMROOT (llm_framework, tracing, fs_tools, fixture_heal), `.endswith("/.rebar/scratch")` / `str(relative_to)` test asserts, and a missing `pypandoc/files/pandoc` on an unpinned platform. The 21 shell-stub lines are the posix-shell root cause and moved to citreous-talented-wildebeest.

Regressions (AC2), run on the pre-fix scripts: 4 failed for the expected reason (`'src\\rebar\\live.py:1: ...'.startswith('src/rebar/live.py:1: ')` False; `FAIL: ../../../../...` instead of absolute POSIX path; `['tests\\test_thing.py'] != ['tests/test_thing.py']`; `_repo_relative` missing). `test_subprocess_env_minimal.py` errored at import (no `minimal_env`). After the fix all pass; 307 tests across the touched modules pass on macOS. Commit d287c64641a (stacked on d782dd17ea6) deletes path-separators.args and posix-shell.args and their test.yml references.
